messages.subject: Scantwoperm P-value Summary list/double parameter error
parts:
Sorry to post such a data-structure help question, but I am having trouble using the results of scantwopermhk to generate threshold values/p-values. The error message shown happens before and after c.scantwoperm combination, and I'm uncertain as to the cause. I assume there is an issue in the perms.wk4 data structure, as the error message only occurs upon inclusion of 'perms=', and summary works correctly independently on s2weight and perms.wk4

> summary(s2weight,lodcolumn=4,perms=perms.wk4,pvalues=TRUE,alphas=c(0.2,0.2,0.0,0.2,0.2))
Error in summary.scantwo(s2weight, lodcolumn = 4, perms = perms.wk4, pvalues = TRUE, :
(list) object cannot be coerced to type 'double'
